documentType: Pooled/group mobile camping rate card - NOT a fixed lodge; per-person rate scales down sharply with group size and vehicle/guide count
notes: Rate structure is fundamentally different from a standard lodge: price per person per night depends on (a) meal plan (Game Package vs Full Board), (b) total group size (2-36 pax), and (c) number of vehicles/guides deployed (1, 2, or 3), because fixed setup costs are spread across the group.

'Booking 3 nights or more' and 'Special 2 nights only' are two different pricing tables - the 2-night table is markedly more expensive per person (front-loaded setup cost), consistent with mobile-camp economics.

Base location assumed is Maasai Mara; a supplementary per-safari cost applies for Samburu, Meru, or Amboseli deployments (see supplementaryLocationCosts). No cost is shown for Maasai Mara itself ('N/A' in source, since that's already the base rate).
Park & Conservation/camp fees are NOT included and are 'advised upon request depending on location' - i.e. genuinely unquoted, not just excluded.

Single supplement policy here (25%/75% of pppn rate depending on number of single tents) differs from the flat single-room/double-room-rate policy used at Seringet Mara Camp - these are two different products from the same operator, don't conflate them.

childPolicy.raw: Sharing with at least 1 adult: 8-12yrs 35% off adult rate; under 8yrs (upon request) 50% off adult rate.

singleSupplementPolicy.raw: 3 or less single tents per booking: 25% supplement on pppn rate. 4 or more single tents: 75% supplement on pppn rate.
singleSupplementPolicy.confidenceNote: Different structure from Seringet Mara Camp's single supplement policy (flat single/double room rate) - these are separate products, do not reuse one policy for the other.

tripleOccupancy.raw: Additional camp bed added to double occupancy tent, subject to availability, children under 12 only.
